page.overview:
What is Zubat?

Zubat serves as a reference to a blue bat. It has a short, round body, purple wings, and slim legs missing feet. Since it has no eyes, it generates sound waves (echolocation) to navigate and communicate with other things around, like a real bat does. Strangely, it can use the move Mean Look, despite not having any eyes. It has very sensitive skin; prolonged exposure to sunlight could mean slight burns, regardless of the outdoor temperature, so Zubat seeks shelter in caves and buildings during the daytime.

Zubat has the ability Inner Focus and the hidden ability Infiltrator. Inner Focus prevents Zubat from flinching. Infiltrator prevents the effects of Reflect, Magic Coat, and Light Screen from working.

Male Zubat have bigger fangs than the females.

Zubat evolves into Golbat starting at level 22 and then evolves into Crobat if leveled up with high friendship.
